text:
Both `header.json` and `units-001.json` have been updated and accepted:

1. **`header.json` (Decision 2)**: Updated so `getCurrentColor({ clientX, clientY })` takes no `raw` parameter and returns `invertDarkModeFilter(rgbToHex(pixel[0], pixel[1], pixel[2]))` when `appState.theme === THEME.DARK` (else the raw hex), feeding `stableProps.onChange`, `colorPreviewDiv.style.background`, and `onSelect`. Recorded that this supersedes `FR-6` ("raw on-screen pixel") per the Gate 2 decision because `.excalidraw-eye-dropper-preview` has `filter: var(--theme-filter)` in dark mode (`EyeDropper.scss:29`, `theme.scss:186`).
2. **`units-001.json` (`U04`)**: Removed the `raw` parameter from rules and sites and dropped the `mouseMoveListener` site (`lines 119..130`), keeping the import site (`S1`), `getCurrentColor` site (`S2`), and `useEffect` dependency array site (`S3`, adding `appState.theme`), with `FR-6` remaining covered by `U04`.
3. **`units-001.json` (`U02`)**: Updated rule 3 and the first test expectation so the dark-theme eyedropper test asserts the `.excalidraw-eye-dropper-preview` swatch `style.background` is `'rgb(30, 30, 30)'` (jsdom-normalised `#1e1e1e`).
4. **`units-001.json` (`U01`)**: Reworded rule 5 and its test expectation to assert `invertDarkModeFilter(applyDarkModeFilter('#1e1e1e80')) === '#1e1e1e80'` and `invertDarkModeFilter(applyDarkModeFilter('#1e1e1e00')) === '#1e1e1e00'`.
